text:
Eleni (Design): quick check 1 — new compact notifications panel mock in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/preview-notifs. focusing on inline preview + reorder + pause affordance. need copy + a11y quick pass.

Marcus (Frontend): looks tidy. question: reorder UX 1 drag handles or explicit move buttons? keyboard support required.

Kai (A11y): explicit move buttons + keyboard shortcuts please. provide live announcements like 'Email moved to position 2'. ensure list semantics (role=list/listitem).

Rhea (PM): small copy call: prefer 'Pause notifications' instead of 'Snooze' or 'Mute' — clearer for customers. tooltip should show duration: 'Pause notifications for 1h'.

Eleni (Design): will update to 'Pause notifications' and add a small paused badge 'Paused  resumes 11:15 AM'. any thoughts on showing example payload when paused?

Kai (A11y): dimmed preview OK, but include visible text 'Channel paused' and aria-live updates when state changes. avoid hiding status only in a tooltip.

Marcus (Frontend): implementation notes: use roving tabindex + Alt+Arrow for reorder, aria-live region for announcements, lazy-load preview content beyond 12 channels. focus styles will be 3px solid token color.

Eleni (Design): also tightening row spacing to 12px and darkening the 'Immediate' badge color to meet 4.5:1.

design-bot: snapshot added: https://bot.redwood/snapshots/1745551234.png :frame_with_picture:

Rhea (PM): perfect. if Kai signs off after a quick a11y pass we'll merge copy + token tweaks. thanks! :tada:
